name: Securities Post Trade Booking
definition: Information used to book the executions of a trade.

DayBooking.name: Day Booking
DayBooking.definition: Indicates whether or not automatic booking can occur.

BookingUnit.name: Booking Unit
BookingUnit.definition: Indicates what constitutes a bookable unit, ie, a partial execution, or an aggregated execution.

BookingType.name: Booking Type
BookingType.definition: Method for booking out an order.

RelatedOrder.name: Related Order
RelatedOrder.definition: Order for which booking instructions are specified.
